title: ALiX audit exception register
description: Exceptions for dependency advisories that have been reviewed and accepted. Mirrors the `ExceptionsFile` and `AdvisoryException` interfaces in src/governance/security/supply-chain/security-exceptions.ts, which is the contract the gate actually consumes. This schema is for editor tooling and review; it does not run in CI. The runtime structural check is validateSecurityExceptionsDocument in src/interfaces/cli/commands/security/doctor.ts.

lastReviewed.description: ISO date of the last full review of this register.

failOnUnexcepted.description: Fail the gate on an advisory with no matching exception. Keep true.

failOnExpired.description: Fail the gate on an expired exception. Keep true.

failSeverity.description: Severity at or above which an unexcepted advisory fails the gate.

warnSeverity.description: Severity at or above which an unexcepted advisory is reported as a warning.

expiryWindowDays.description: Maximum permitted lifetime of a new exception, in days.

advisories.description: Accepted-risk entries. Each entry must name the package or advisory it covers, and must carry an owner and an expiry.

package.description: Affected package name. Matching on package name pre-authorises any future advisory for that package; prefer a GHSA id when the exposure is specific.

reason.description: Why the risk is acceptable. Must describe the current tree, not the tree at creation time.
